findings.affected_surface: codeforge subagent writer, live-file schema, freshness, and P1 acceptance
findings.claim: The plan gives mutually exclusive instructions for whether subagent data is written to a separate tasks file or merged into the main live file.
findings.evidence: Section 2.5 requires two files with one writer each. The file-structure map instead says subagent_statusline.rs merges into the same live file using read-modify-write. P1.3 restores the separate tasks file, while P1.5 says the previously named main file carries a tasks row. Section 6 again says no shared file or read-modify-write exists.
findings.repair: Make every reference require subagent_statusline.rs to write only <live-dir>/context/<sid>.tasks.json. Change P1.5 to validate the tasks row in that file and explicitly prohibit merging or read-modify-write against <sid>.json.

findings.affected_surface: live-directory fallback and context-budget state compatibility
findings.claim: The fallback path composition does not preserve the legacy context-budget state path as promised.
findings.evidence: Section 2.5 defines the resolved SSD fallback as ~/.autopilot/context-budget/. P2.2 then places state in <live-dir>/context-budget/, yielding ~/.autopilot/context-budget/context-budget/. Section 2.6 says the state remains at the legacy path when no RAM-backed directory is available.
findings.repair: Define an unambiguous base-directory contract, preferably using ~/.autopilot as the SSD fallback base so appending context-budget produces the exact legacy path. Alternatively return explicit per-purpose paths. Add an assertion for the exact SSD-fallback state pathname.

findings.claim: The normative family parser and the required negative tests prescribe opposite block decisions.
findings.evidence: Section 2.5 lowercases the model id and takes the text before the first hyphen after removing an optional claude- prefix. That maps both CLAUDE-FABLE-5-1 and fable-ish to family fable. P3.3 nevertheless requires uppercase variants and fable-ish not to block.
findings.repair: Specify a recognized model-id grammar before family extraction and align the tests. A coherent contract is to lowercase canonical claude-prefixed IDs, require valid version segments, treat fable-ish as unknown, and require uppercase canonical Fable or Opus IDs to block after normalization.

findings.claim: The stated older-codeforge skew behavior is not old behavior because the new default-on gate still emits warnings without a live file.
findings.evidence: Section 6 says older codeforge produces no live file and therefore old behavior. Section 2.6 identifies depth0-delegate-gate as a new default-on source of stderr, and P3.1 explicitly says an absent live file still warns while merely disabling blocking.
findings.repair: To satisfy the frozen skew contract, make depth0-delegate-gate a no-op when the main live file is absent or stale, while retaining default-on warn and explicit block behavior when a fresh file exists. Add tests for both repository-skew directions.
